hypothesis: Graph Neural Network applies learned structural patterns to adversarially perturbed data to generate creatively modified outputs under vulnerability constraints
description: This method leverages graph structures to model relationships within adversarial inputs, allowing the model to explore alternative representations while maintaining creative divergence; by training on perturbed but semantically valid examples, it learns to produce novel outputs without collapsing into trivial or predictable variations, potentially overcoming standard limitations of adversarial training.
